jobs.description:
Job Location (Short): Madison, Alabama-USA

Workplace Type: Remote

Req Id: 3451

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

As an RMS Implementation Analyst, you will use your experience to help adapt our agencies business processes to the newly installed solutions. This results-driven professional will be responsible for helping agencies prioritize and adapt their needs within a given timetable. Primarily, you will aid in the installation, training, and adapting our product suite during the implementation timeline and manage the day-to-day tasks to keep the customer to the configuration timeline.

* Implementation, configuration, and training of core software
* Setting of goals and expectations for configuration timelines with our customers
* Tracking and reporting on actual progress made by customers to the internal project group
* Working with software developers and project support teams
* Meeting with system users to understand common workflows and scope
* Helping agencies to meet needs with out of the box solutions
* Communicating findings to technical and non-technical colleagues
* Other duties as assigned

  

#LI-Remote #LI-SK1

**Education / Qualifications**
------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related field or commensurate, documented experience in a role with similar responsibilities.
* Law Enforcement RMS experience required
* MSSQL or Oracle database and scripting knowledge and experience is preferred but not required.
* SSRS Report writing knowledge and experience is preferred but not required.
* Microsoft Power BI knowledge and experience is preferred but not required.
* Experience in public safety workflows and software preferred but not required.
* Excellent communication and critical thinking skills.
* Good organizational skills and detail-oriented mindset.

**About Octave**
----------------

Octave provides mission-critical software that empowers organizations to make informed decisions across every stage of the asset lifecycle - Design, Build, Operate and Protect - where performance, safety, and reliability are non-negotiable and failure is not an option.

Turning complex operational data into actionable intelligence, Octave connects expertise, real-world conditions and enterprise-scale insight to improve performance, resilience and incident response where it matters most.

Octave has more than 7,000 employees in 45 countries. Learn more at octave.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

**Why work for Octave?**
------------------------

All in. Always forward. That's the way we do things around here. We put trust in our people because we believe it's the best way to unleash potential, bring ideas to life, and keep moving ahead. And it's why we're committed to creating an environment that's truly supportive, providing you with the resources you need to support your ambitions, no matter who you are or where you are in the world.

**Everyone is welcome**
-----------------------

At Octave, we believe that diverse and inclusive teams are critical to the success of our people and our business. Here, everyone is welcome. As an inclusive workplace, we don't discriminate. In fact, we embrace differences and are fully committed to creating equal opportunities, an inclusive environment, and fairness for all.

Respect is the cornerstone of how we operate, so speak up and be yourself. You're valued here.

### **Recruitment Fraud Alert**

Octave posts all official job opportunities on either https://careers.octave.com/ or https://www.octave.com/about/careers and communicates only from email addresses ending in @octave.com. We never request payment or personal banking information during recruitment. No offers will ever be extended without a proper interview via Teams or in person, never done over email alone. If you suspect fraud, it probably is, and contact us at careers@octave.com

A genuine desire to make a difference in the lives of others is the foundation for everything we do. With a customer-first mindset and an intentional focus on building strong teams, we’ve been able to uphold our legacy of financial stability while investing in new, innovative technologies that support the needs of our customers. Our high-performance culture focused on operational excellence thrives thanks to remarkable people united by compassion and a customer-first commitment. Are you ready to make a difference?

**Job Summary**

  

In this customer‑facing role, you will lead and manage the on‑boarding process for new Employee Benefits groups in the small‑case market. You’ll gather and validate sold‑case information, coordinate with internal partners to ensure accurate contract drafting and billing, guide customers through installation, and deliver a smooth, informed transition to ongoing service. You’ll use your understanding of the on‑boarding lifecycle to resolve issues, build trust with customers, and bring forward insights that support continuous improvement.

* Gather and confirm sold‑case information from sales, producers, and customers.
* Submit accurate group data to Policyholder Services and partner through the scrub process.

Bring customer insights to continuous improvement efforts and collaborate on process enhancements.

**Education:** High School Diploma or Equivalent, Bachelor’s degree preferred

* Experience in project management, benefits administration, case management, customer service, or sales.
* Demonstrated ability to resolve customer issues and manage complex on‑boarding activities.
* Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools.
* Background collaborating with cross‑functional teams in a process‑driven environment.
Familiarity with contract setup, billing processes, or Policyholder Services operations.

* **Adaptability:** Adjusts quickly to changing priorities and sees possibilities in evolving circumstances.
* **Customer Focus:** Builds trust through clear communication, proactive problem solving, and ownership of outcomes.
* **Winning Together:** Works effectively with diverse internal and external partners to move work forward.

We have built an enduring legacy of stability, financial strength and exceptional customer service through the contributions of the service-oriented people who choose to work at The Standard. To ensure we can attract and retain the best talent, when you join The Standard you can expect:

* A rich benefits package including medical, dental, vision and a 401(k) plan with matching company contributions

jobs.description:

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Masimo, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

Our mission is, Masimo innovations empower clinicians to transform patient care. When you join our team, you’ll be part of a culture that’s driven by passion, challenging the status quo, and making an impact in the lives of others.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The **Implementation Project Manager** is responsible for The Implementation Project Manager is accountable for the successful end-to-end delivery of implementation projects, serving as the primary owner and point of accountability from project initiation through project completion. This role is responsible for aligning organizational priorities, managing project execution, and coordinating cross-functional resources to ensure deliverables are completed on time, within scope, and in alignment with customer expectations and business objectives.

This position reports to the **Regional Manager Implementations** and is part of **Clinical Implementations** and will be working remotely to cover the **Mid Atlantic Region**.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of 15+ concurrent implementation projects, ensuring alignment with business priorities, timelines, scope, and budgets.
* Define project scope, develop comprehensive project plans, and coordinate resources to achieve project goals and deliverables.
* Manage stakeholder relationships and provide direction to internal and external teams to ensure customer satisfaction and patient care standards.
* Monitor project progress, risks, barriers, and scope changes while providing weekly status reports and implementing effective solutions.
* Drive continuous process improvement, strengthen team proficiency in project management methodologies, and foster lasting customer relationships.

**The essential requirements of the job include****:**

* Experience working in hospital/hospital type environments;
* Must have independent work skills, a strong work ethic, strong leadership skills and the ability to handle difficult customer situations;
* Possess excellent diplomacy and negotiation skills;
* Ability to communicate with all levels of hospital administration and Masimo cross functional teams;
* Ability to perform overnight travel at a minimum of 50% each month;

**Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:** *if applicable for role*

* Ability to travel overnight per outlined travel requirements;
* Ensure continuous compliance with hospital vendor credentialing standards by maintaining current credentials, immunizations, training records, and access requirements

* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification;
* Experience implementing clinical monitoring systems, healthcare technology, medical devices, or enterprise software solutions.
* Working knowledge of hospital clinical, operational, and technical workflows and their impact on implementation planning, customer readiness, training, and adoption.

Masimo, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job.

At Masimo we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Masimo can provide.

The annual salary range for this role is $100,000- $120,000. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

**Bonus / Incentive Pay**

10% of annual base salary

This job is also eligible for bonus / incentive pay. This is the target earnings as % of base annual salary, subject to objective eligibility criteria and performance conditions as set out in the applicable scheme terms and conditions.

  

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

  

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

jobs.title: Sr. Workfront Implementation Consultant (Remote, Contract)
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**
=====================

**The Sr. Workfront Implementation Consultant** guides enterprise clients through the assessment, design, configuration, and implementation of Adobe Workfront solutions. The role translates business goals and work management needs into scalable workflows, practical processes, and solution designs that improve adoption and deliver measurable value.  
  
This consultant leads strategic Workfront implementations, partners with stakeholders across the content supply chain, and supports organizational change and process optimization. The role connects Workfront with relevant Adobe technologies and complementary applications while helping clients achieve successful launches and sustained business outcomes.  
  
**Location:** Remote - United States  
Please note this is a **contract role.**  

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Workfront Solution Design & Implementation**
----------------------------------------------

* Design and configure enterprise-level Workfront business process solutions that address client goals and improve work management effectiveness.
* Lead clients through strategic implementations, balancing long-term business value with immediate operational needs.
* Create project plans, solution designs, templates, layouts, queues, custom forms, reports, and supporting implementation materials.
* Provide high-quality consulting services through implementation, launch, and go-live readiness.

**Workflow Optimization & Adobe Ecosystem Alignment**

* Assess existing business processes and recommend scalable workflows, process improvements, and practical adoption strategies.
* Align Workfront solutions with relevant Adobe products and stages of the content supply chain, including planning, creation, review, approval, and content management.
* Identify additional client needs and opportunities to increase Workfront adoption and business value.

**Client Leadership & Practice Improvement**

* Serve as a Workfront business process and configuration subject matter expert for clients and internal stakeholders.
* Mentor and coach client teams, provide knowledge resources, and support escalations and solution adoption.
* Contribute lessons learned and reusable practices to continually improve delivery and implementation methodologies.

**Required Skills & Experience**
================================

**Workfront & Enterprise Consulting**
-------------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree and demonstrated business process consulting experience.
* 5+ years of experience in business process or management consulting, specifically with Adobe Workfront.
* Proven experience delivering end-to-end Workfront solutions for large enterprise organizations, including organizations with 5,000+ employees.
* Ability to assess, design, document, and optimize business processes and work management workflows.
* Experience guiding client stakeholders through implementation, solution adoption, and complex change.

**Technical & Adobe Platform Knowledge**

* Understanding of the broader Adobe ecosystem, including products such as Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign, and Adobe Target.
* Strong technical aptitude; exposure to API-driven integrations, migrations, enhancements, and third-party software integrations.
* Familiarity with RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

**Consulting & Communication Skills**

* Strong interpersonal, communication, relationship-building, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
* Ability to prioritize multiple workstreams, evaluate interconnected challenges, and recommend practical solutions.
* Ability to lead solution adoption, collaborate with diverse stakeholders, and share knowledge through coaching and mentoring.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**
=================================

* Experience with organizational change management methodologies.
* Knowledge of the broader content supply chain, including Workfront Planning, Creative Cloud, Frame.io, Adobe Experience Manager, Marketo, Adobe Experience Platform, and related solutions.

**Role Expectations**
=====================

* Work effectively across enterprise client engagements and support delivery of outcomes aligned to business priorities.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 20%, with travel up to 50% possible for some engagements.

**About Blue Acorn iCi**

Blue Acorn iCi, a business unit of Infosys Nova Holdings, LLC, is a digital experience partner helping global brands design, build, and optimize the future of customer engagement. Specializing in the Adobe Experience Cloud, we provide end-to-end services across commerce, content, analytics, and customer insights. Backed by Infosys, we’re growing fast—and we’re looking for exceptional talent to grow with us.

Our teams work at the intersection of strategy and execution—solving complex challenges for industry leaders in healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and beyond. From large-scale digital transformation programs to platform implementations and ongoing optimization, we bring deep expertise and a collaborative mindset to every engagement.

**Why Join Us?**

Blue Acorn iCi is a place for curious thinkers, smart builders, and digital pioneers. We’re more than a consultancy—we’re a team of innovators helping the world’s top brands shape the future of digital.

Here, you won’t just contribute to a project—you’ll drive meaningful outcomes, collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams, and grow your skills in a high-impact, high-growth environment. We believe great work starts with great people, and we’re committed to creating a culture where talent thrives, ideas spark change, and results speak for themselves.

If you’re ready to push boundaries, deliver real value, and help shape the next generation of digital experiences—this is your place.

jobs.title: AI and Automation Implementation Manager, Corporate Marketing
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

**Role Summary**

WTW is navigating a period of significant, sustained transformation shaped by global market shifts, advances in technology, AI and automation, and the evolving expectations of our colleagues and clients. Corporate Marketing is embedding AI, automation and data more deeply into how work gets done, creating a unique opportunity to help redesign marketing workflows for greater speed, quality and impact.

This is a hands-on, individual contributor role for someone who combines strong marketing knowledge with proven experience implementing and developing AI and automation solutions for marketing or similar commercial teams. Reporting to the Head of Digital Marketing, this role will help turn the Corporate Marketing AI roadmap into practical, adopted workflow improvements across brand and content quality, creative asset production, campaign delivery, digital marketing, events, intake, approvals, reporting and analytics.

Working as part of the broader Marketing and Communication (M&C) AI and automation capability – alongside a Shared AI Solutions Developer and the AI and Automation Manager, Corporate Communication – this role will partner with Corporate Marketing, Segment Marketing, IT, Sales Operations, Analytics and external vendors to understand current workflows, diagnose friction and assess AI and automation capabilities across the MarTech stack, including Adobe, Marketo, Sitecore, Wrike, Cvent, Power BI and Microsoft 365.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Translate the Corporate Marketing AI and automation roadmap into practical, adopted workflows that simplify how marketing work gets done and reduce manual effort.
* Help identify and prioritize workflow improvement opportunities across brand and content quality, creative asset production, campaign delivery, digital marketing, events, intake, approvals, reporting and analytics.
* Partner with Corporate Marketing, Segment Marketing, IT, Sales Operations, Analytics and external vendors to understand current workflows, diagnose friction and design more effective ways of working within Corporate Marketing's platforms, standards and processes.
* Assess AI and automation capabilities across the MarTech stack – including Adobe, Marketo, Sitecore, Wrike, Cvent, Power BI, Microsoft 365 and other vendor tools – to reduce duplication, improve self-service and support better planning decisions.
* Work closely with the Shared AI Solutions Developer to translate workflow reviews and business requirements into practical, technically sound solutions, providing marketing context and prioritization to guide build decisions.
* Partner with the AI and Automation Manager, Corporate Communication to share learnings, avoid duplication of effort and maintain a consistent approach to AI and automation across M&C.
* Help marketers use data, trends and performance insight to improve future content and campaign decisions.
* Support adoption through simple guidance, playbooks, training materials and benefit tracking so teams can see what has changed, how to use it and what value it delivers.
* Champion innovative approaches to AI, automation, analytics and emerging technologies to strengthen marketing effectiveness and colleague experience.
* Establish measures of success for specific marketing efforts– including reduced process complexity, improved cycle times, increased self-service and reduced manual effort – and report progress to the Head of Digital Marketing, the Global Marketing and Communication Operations Lead and Corporate Marketing leadership.
* Build trusted relationships across Corporate Marketing, Segment Marketing leadership, IT, Sales Operations, Analytics and external vendors.
* Maintain external benchmarking and market insight on AI, automation and MarTech trends, bringing best practice into Corporate Marketing's roadmap and priorities.
* Model WTW values – client focus, teamwork, respect, excellence and integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Strong, well-rounded marketing knowledge, including some combination of brand, content, creative production, campaign delivery, digital marketing and/or marketing operations.
* Proven experience implementing and developing AI and automation solutions for marketing or similar commercial teams, including workflow redesign, process simplification and tool evaluation.
* Fluency in how AI and automation are reshaping marketing work, with experience leveraging AI-enabled tools (such as Copilot or equivalent) to elevate quality, efficiency and effectiveness.
* Working knowledge of the MarTech landscape (e.g., Adobe, Marketo, Sitecore, Wrike, Cvent, Power BI, Microsoft 365) and the ability to assess capabilities and identify practical improvement opportunities.
* Ability to translate business needs into clear requirements for a technical developer to build against; comfortable partnering closely with a solutions developer without formal people management responsibility.
* Strong analytical mindset – adept at using data, benchmarks and metrics to identify friction, prioritize opportunities and measure impact.
* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills; able to build trust and influence marketing leaders and colleagues without formal authority.
* Highly organized, detail-oriented and adaptable; skilled at managing multiple concurrent priorities across geographies and time zones.
* Experience designing adoption support materials, including simple guidance, playbooks and training content.
* Aptitude to synthesize direction, navigate ambiguity and prioritize actions from a variety of stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in marketing, communication, business, technology or a related field.
* Experience working within a large, complex, global organization preferred.

**Location**: United States (Remote)

**Note**: Employment-based non-immigrant visa sponsorship and/or assistance is not offered for this specific job opportunity

  

**Compensation and Benefits**

Base salary range and benefits information for this position are being included in accordance with requirements of various state/local pay transparency legislation. Please note that salaries may vary for different individuals in the same role based on several factors, including but not limited to location of the role, individual competencies, education/professional certifications, qualifications/experience, performance in the role.

  

**Compensation**

The base salary compensation range being offered for this role is $120,000-$150,000 USD annually. This role is also eligible for an annual short-term incentive bonus.

  

**Company Benefits**

WTW provides a competitive benefit package which includes the following (eligibility requirements apply):

* **Health and Welfare Benefits:** Mental health/emotional wellbeing (including Employee Assistance Program), medical (including prescription drug coverage and fertility benefits), dental, vision, Health Savings Account, Commuter Accounts, Health Care and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts, company-paid life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD&D, group accident, group critical illness, group legal, identify theft protection, wellbeing program, adoption assistance, surrogacy assistance, auto/home insurance, pet insurance and other work/life resources
* **Leave Benefits:** Paid holidays, annual paid time off (includes state/local paid leave where required), company-paid disability (short-term and long-term disability), other leaves (e.g., bereavement, FMLA, ADA, jury duty, military leave, and Parental and Adoption Leave), Paid Time Off
* **Retirement Benefits:** Qualified contributory pension plan (if eligible) and 401(k) plan with annual nonelective company contribution. Non-qualified retirement plans available to senior level colleagues who satisfy the plans’ eligibility requirements

  

*Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

  

This position will remain posted for a minimum of three business days from the date posted or until sufficient/appropriate candidate slate has been identified.

  

**EOE, including disability/vets**

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. **Accountability** - Accepts personal responsibility and/or consequences of failure and successes, delivering on commitments and refocusing effort when needed. Someone who is willing to step up and own it.

* Create and maintain standard operating procedures on assigned book of business to train peers and support cross functional collaboration across the team.

* Consistent partnership with Talent Acquisition Leadership to review escalations and proactively mitigate risks.
* Navigate difficult conversations with heightened discretion to properly rescind offers, push start dates, and discuss background findings with new hires while maintaining confidentiality.
* Maintain understanding of internal and external system integrations to troubleshoot any system gaps and enable cross functional collaboration with our IT, Workday, and External partners.
* Continuously refine and implement onboarding controls and audits to reduce risk.
* Execute additional HR projects as assigned.

**Other Preferred Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* 3-5 years of previous experience in a similar field, talent onboarding experience is preferred
* Clear communication and problem solving skills required
* Bachelors Degree or equivalent experience

jobs.title: Professional Services Manager (Implementation Manager)
jobs.description:
At First Advantage (Nasdaq: FA), people are at the heart of everything we do. From our customers and partners to our greatest advantage — our team members. Operating with empathy and compassion, First Advantage fosters a global inclusive workforce devoted to the diverse voices that make up our talent and products. Our team members empower each other to be their authentic selves and treat all with respect, integrity, and fairness.  
  
Say hello to a rewarding career and come join a leading provider of mission-critical background screening solutions to some of the most recognized Fortune 100 and Global 500 brands.

**What You’ll Do****:**

As **Professional Services Manager** (Implementation) you will be the connective tissue between customer requirements and successful onboarding to the First Advantage program. Owning implementations from discovery through go-live, you will translate technical and operational requirements into practical business solutions, align customers and internal teams around clear decisions, and accelerate time to revenue without compromising quality or customer outcomes.

This is a customer-facing role for someone who can move confidently between business strategy, solution design, project execution, and stakeholder influence. You will bring structure to ambiguity and guide customers toward scalable best-practice solutions.

This is a 100% remote position; however, the individual must be based in the United States and be available to travel up to 25%.

**Responsibilities**:

* Lead implementations across the First Advantage product portfolio, from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live, stabilization, and transition to Customer Success.
* Turn customer business and technical requirements into scalable, supportable solutions. Lead discovery, explain trade-offs and constraints, and guide customers toward best-practice decisions.
* Build and govern customer-centric implementation plans with clear scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, decisions, and success measures.
* Negotiate scope, priorities, timelines, responsibilities, and solution choices with customers and internal stakeholders while maintaining trusted relationships.
* Orchestrate delivery across Sales, Product, Technology, Operations, Customer Success, ATS/HRIS partners, and customer teams, resolving blockers and holding stakeholders accountable.
* Lead integration planning, configuration, and pre- and post-production testing. Coding is not required, but technical fluency and strong solution leadership is essential.
* Drive progress toward go-live and first revenue, proactively managing scope creep, delivery risk, customer dependencies, and recovery plans.
* Use lessons learned and customer insights to improve implementation playbooks, reusable solutions, and delivery processes, while sharing expertise with peers.

**How You’ll Work**:

* High Emotional Intelligence: Listen actively, adapt your communication, and navigate challenging discussions while maintaining trust.
* Collaborative Influence: Build alignment without relying on authority and move teams toward clear decisions and shared accountability.
* Business Acumen: Connect implementation choices to customer outcomes, operational impact, revenue, risk, and scalability.
* Creative Curiosity: Ask incisive questions, explore root causes, and design practical solutions that balance customer needs with delivery standards.
* Learning Agility: Experiment thoughtfully, learn from setbacks, and adjust quickly without losing momentum.

**What Success Looks like**:

* Customers understand the implementation path, decisions required, and responsibilities needed to adopt the agreed solution.
* Projects are tightly scoped and actively governed, with transparent ownership, risks, decisions, and next steps.
* Solutions are technically feasible, commercially sound, scalable, and aligned with best practice.
* Cross-functional teams align early, blockers are resolved quickly, and avoidable rework and customization are reduced.
* Implementations reach go-live and first revenue with speed, predictability, and customer confidence.

**What You Will Need to be Successful:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional work experience.
* 5+ years leading complex implementations, professional services engagements, solution delivery, or comparable customer onboarding programs in B2B SaaS.
* Demonstrated strength in discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, scope and risk management, project governance, testing, and launch readiness.
* Proven ability to negotiate, influence through expertise and data, and hold customer and internal stakeholders accountable to commitments.
* Ability to translate integrations, APIs, data exchange, configuration, and ATS/HRIS concepts into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. Coding experience is not required.
* Excellent facilitation, executive presence, presentation, written communication, analytical judgment, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* Experience partnering with Sales or pre-sales, Product, Technology, Operations, and Client Success.

Helpful, But Not Required

* Experience in background screening, HR technology, HCM, identity, compliance technology, or another complex or regulated B2B environment such as financial services or healthcare.
* Solutions consulting, technical account management, or pre-sales solutioning experience.
* Experience using AI-enabled tools, automation, or analytics to improve implementation speed, quality, documentation, or decision-making.
* Formal project or change management certification.

**Why First Advantage is Your Next Big Career Move:**  
  
First Advantage is going through a technology transformation! We are looking for experts who are excited to work with advanced technologies and provide best-in-class user experience, drive the development and deployment of scalable solutions, and smoothly guide our agile teams and clients through meaningful changes as we continue to expand our impact.  
Additional benefits offered to our eligible people include:

* Ability to work remotely with occasional business travel.
* Medical, Vision, Dental, and supplementary benefit plans
* 401k with an employer match, and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
* Competitive and flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) and 9 paid company holidays
* Access to tech and growth opportunities, and leaders who want you to succeed!

**What Are You Waiting For? Apply Today!**  
You have learned a little about us today – we want to learn about you! If you think this position and our company are a great fit for your areas of interest and expertise, tell us about you by applying now!

**POSITION SUMMARY:**  
The EHR Application Analyst Senior serves as an advanced-level contributor in the support, optimization, and ongoing development of the Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. Operating with a high degree of independence, this role handles complex technical issues, leads system optimization efforts, and serves as a resource and mentor for junior analysts. The EHR Application Analyst Senior applies deep knowledge of EHR capabilities and healthcare business workflows to drive improvements that enhance clinical and operational performance.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Advanced System Support and Maintenance:
* Serve as a primary escalation point for complex technical issues and system errors, applying advanced troubleshooting techniques to ensure timely resolution and minimal disruption to patient care.
* Provide day-to-day technical support to end-users, including troubleshooting issues, answering questions, and resolving system errors to ensure uninterrupted use of the EHR system.
* Provide guidance to junior analysts on day-to-day support challenges, sharing expertise and building team capability.
* Lead and coordinate routine maintenance activities, including software updates, patches, and upgrades, to ensure the stability and security of the EHR system.
* Coordinate testing and validation activities for system changes, enhancements, and upgrades, ensuring new features meet functional requirements without introducing unintended disruptions.
* Participate in on-call rotations, including taking lead responsibility for after-hours coverage on complex or escalated issues.

System Optimization:

* Lead efforts to optimize the performance, usability, and efficiency of the EHR system.
* Conduct workflow assessments with operational partners to identify build inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and advance optimization requests through appropriate governance and change management channels.
* Apply cross-application integration knowledge to identify dependencies and ensure cohesive system performance across modules.

Collaboration and Vendor Engagement:

* Take ownership of defined work streams or components within EHR implementation projects, system upgrades, and other initiatives.
* Coordinate task assignments, track progress, and communicate status to project leads, ensuring deliverables are completed on time and within scope.
* Own ongoing relationships with EHR vendor support, including managing open support requests, evaluating release notes for operational impact, and representing the organization in user group sessions and advisory forums.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams - including IT, clinicians, administrators, and vendors - to support EHR initiatives and facilitate effective communication across stakeholder groups.

Documentation and Knowledge Management:

* Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, processes, and procedures.
* Establish knowledge-sharing practices to ensure critical information is accessible and current across the team.

Training and Mentorship:

* Provide training and mentorship to junior analysts and end-users, sharing best practices to enhance team capabilities and support continuous professional development.

Compliance and Data Privacy

* Handle all protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations and organizational data privacy and security policies.
* Complete required compliance training and model information security best practices for the team.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

* Excellent analytical, organization, and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and within teams.
* Ability to solve complex problems and understand translate customer needs into system solutions.
* Strong understanding of healthcare business process, workflows, and terminology.
* Cross-application integration knowledge.
* Proficient in Microsoft 365 or equivalent productivity tools.
* Degree in Computer Science, healthcare or related field.

* Minimum two (2) to five (5) years of experience as an EHR Application Analyst, Health IT Analyst, Epic Analyst, or in a related healthcare information systems role.

jobs.title: Training Specialist
jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote- Eligible US Locations

**About the role and about You:**

Great support starts with great training. When our members hit a snag, our Community Support team gets them back into Watopia and helps them make the most of their Zwift experience. To help support our frontline agents, we're hiring a hands-on Training Specialist to build and maintain the training they rely on.

Our training program already has a strong foundation: a structured new hire curriculum, an established design framework, and experienced subject matter expert trainers who facilitate instructor-led training. In this role, you'll keep that program accurate and effective as Zwift evolves. When products, processes, or policies change, you'll revise new hire training and build and deploy update training to match. When the team identifies a need for refresh training, you'll build it. When something new and complex launches, you'll be a crucial part of supporting it.

You'll be a part of our Content & Learning team, who own training, user-facing self-service content, and the internal knowledge enabling Zwift's support team. In this role, you'll also be the subject-matter expert in Seismic, our learning management system, ensuring we're maximizing the benefits of the tool, keeping groups and enrollments clean, tracking completion and assessment results, and partnering with our BPO partners to close gaps.

You're organized, dependable, and easy to work with. You take direction well, own your work from start to finish, and partner effectively with your teammates. You know when to hold firm on accuracy and when to flex on format or timing. You're comfortable working outside a defined box: you pick up new tools, figure things out on your own, take on new work as the team's needs change, and handle shifting priorities with ease. You use AI thoughtfully, knowing where it speeds up work and where human validation is essential.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop new eLearning and instructor-led training (including exams and certifications) to support product launches and updated policies and procedures, while keeping existing training current.
* Build and deploy refresh training when the team identifies a need, indicated by QA results, Customer Effort Scores, or related performance data.
* Host train-the-trainer sessions to prepare subject matter expert (SME) trainers for seasonal new hire classes and update training rollouts.
* Run regular audits of training materials with SMEs to catch inaccurate, outdated, or missing information.
* Build and sustain strong working relationships with SME trainers, partner teams, and BPO leaders, rooting feedback in curiosity and respect while openly receiving it in return.
* Own Seismic (our LMS): managing distribution groups, reporting on completion and assessment results, and working with BPO leaders to close gaps. Explore unused and emerging features, while recommending ones worth adopting.

**What we're looking for:**

* 2+ years of instructional design, training, or learning and development experience.
* Experience building eLearning, instructor-led training, and assessments using ADDIE or a similar model, with tools such as Articulate or Camtasia.
* Familiar with Kirkpatrick or a similar model for measuring training effectiveness.
* Experience as an LMS administrator using tools like Seismic (formerly Lessonly), Docebo, or equivalent, including user groups, enrollments, and reporting.
* Experience facilitating virtual training, including train-the-trainer sessions, ideally with globally distributed or BPO teams.
* Flexibility with an eagerness to support your team beyond training when priorities shift, whether for a short-term need or a longer-term change in focus.

**Bonus points:**

* A passion for cycling, running, or fitness.
* Experience supporting both internal and BPO (outsourced) contact center teams.
* Familiarity with Zwift, gaming, the software industry, or fitness technology.
  

*I**f Zwift determines in any stage of our interviews that any AI tools are being used without disclosure or citation, your candidacy will be disqualified.*

  

**For All US Based Full-Time Positions:**

The base salary for this position ranges between$56,500- $88,500. The base salary will be based on a number of factors including the role offered, the individual's job-related knowledge, skills, qualifications, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, Zwift is proud to offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package for all eligible employees which also includes performance bonuses, equity, and a full range of medical, financial, and other perks and benefits.

**How to stand out among the rest:**

Your resume/CV is enough to show off your skills, accomplishments, and experience. However, if you choose to include a cover letter introducing us to your awesome personality, we will read that too.

We strongly believe that different backgrounds and ideas are a competitive advantage; we hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. Zwift is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by emailing careers@zwift.com.
